proposals.before: On the last day of the eleventh month, the day Renzi, there was a solar eclipse.
proposals.after: On the last day of the eleventh month, the day Guimao, there was a solar eclipse.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸卯 is Guimao, not Renzi; the idiomatic day name does not match the source.

proposals.before: In the eleventh month on the last day of the month Renzi, there was a solar eclipse.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month on the last day of the month Guimao, there was a solar eclipse.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸卯 is Guimao; the literal incorrectly says Renzi.

proposals.after: On the day Guiyou in the sixth month, the carved screen of the eastern gate tower of Weiyang Palace was damaged by fire.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸酉 is Guiyou, not Guichou.

proposals.after: He appointed Superintendent of the Capital Zhou Yafu as Chariot and Cavalry General, Protector of Dependent States Han as Garrison General, and Palace Assistant Zhang Wu as Restorer of Soil General. proposals.after: He commanded Superintendent of the Capital Zhou Yafu to be Chariot and Cavalry General, Protector of the Dependent States Han to be Garrison General, Palace Assistant Zhang Wu to be Restorer of Soil General, mobilizing 16,000 troops from nearby counties and 15,000 troops from the Capital District; burying through the outer walls and covering with earth was assigned to General Wu.
proposals.reason: Chinese 臧郭穿復土 is a task phrase, not a personal name Zang Guo Chuang.

proposals.before: The ministers followed and arrived. The court deliberated, saying: "Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, General-in-Chief Chen Wu, Grandee Secretary Zhang Cang, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Ying, Marquis Zhu Xu Liu Zhang, Marquis Dong Mou Liu Xingju, and Court Receptionist Liu Jie bowed twice and addressed Your Majesty: Zi Hong and the others are not sons of Emperor Xiaohui and should not serve at the ancestral temple.
proposals.after: The ministers followed and arrived. The court deliberated, saying: "Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, General-in-Chief Chai Wu, Grandee Secretary Zhang Cang, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Ying, Marquis Zhu Xu Liu Zhang, Marquis Dong Mou Liu Xingju, and Court Receptionist Liu Jie bowed twice and addressed Your Majesty: Zi Hong and the others are not sons of Emperor Xiaohui and should not serve at the ancestral temple.
proposals.reason: Same officer later appears as Chai Wu (柴武); Chen Wu invents a different English surname not present in the Chinese 武.

proposals.before: The King of Wu is my elder brother to me;
proposals.after: The King of Wu is an elder brother to me;
proposals.reason: Literal 'is my elder brother to me' is ungrammatical and obscures the kinship wording 兄也.

decisions.reason: Source 癸卯 is the day Guimao; Renzi would be 壬子, so the proposed day-name correction matches the Chinese.
Source 癸卯 is Guimao; the literal's Renzi does not match the sexagenary day in the Chinese.
Source 癸酉 is Guiyou; Guichou would be 癸丑, so the proposed correction is required.

decisions.after: He appointed Superintendent of the Capital Zhou Yafu as Chariot and Cavalry General, Protector of Dependent States Han as Garrison General, and Palace Assistant Zhang Wu as Restorer of Soil General. He mobilized 16,000 troops from nearby counties and 15,000 from the Capital District; excavating the outer burial enclosure and covering it with earth was assigned to General Wu.
decisions.reason: 臧郭穿復土 is a burial-earthwork task assigned to General Wu, not a person named Zang Guo Chuang; the proposal rightly removes the invented name, but 'covering them with earth' misreads 復土 as covering the walls rather than backfilling the excavated enclosure.

decisions.after: He commanded Superintendent of the Capital Zhou Yafu to be Chariot and Cavalry General, Protector of the Dependent States Han to be Garrison General, Palace Assistant Zhang Wu to be Restorer of Soil General, mobilizing 16,000 troops from nearby counties and 15,000 troops from the Capital District; excavating the outer burial enclosure and covering it with earth was assigned to General Wu.
decisions.reason: 臧郭穿復土 is a task phrase under General Wu, not the name Zang Guo Chuang; the proposal correctly rejects the invented person, but 'burying through the outer walls' is awkward and inaccurate for 臧郭穿復土.
The Chinese names only 大將軍臣武; expanding with the surname Chen invents a different person, whereas Chai Wu (柴武) is the attested General-in-Chief.
Only 武 appears here; Chen Wu invents the wrong surname, and Chai Wu correctly identifies the General-in-Chief intended by the annal.
吳王於朕，兄也 marks kinship 'elder brother to me'; the original 'my elder brother to me' is ungrammatical, and the proposed wording restores the 於朕 structure without changing meaning.
